== Notes ==
* Although only the two bosses Ferk Mallet and [[Vulg Painbrain]] share the two spawn locations, sometimes one of those locations is vacant and only one of those two bosses is present. Note that the boss spawning on the southern location will usually start moving as soon as a player comes into radar range and may ambush players from behind when they are moving forward on the regular mission path, if they advance slowly.
